summary: Uuid::get_version incorrectly returned Some(Version::Max) for any UUID with version nibble 0xf, including ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-fffffffffff0. The fix adds an is_max() guard so only the all-ones UUID receives Version::Max; other UUIDs with that nibble return None. The regression test added by this commit checks this case. Reversing only the guard restores the incorrect behavior.
